worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.summary: Whips sharp leaves into a spinning vortex that races to the target, shreds it and bursts; the recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk. The maelstrom form leaves a leaf field at the impact point that keeps cutting, at the cost of single-target power and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.use.1: Maelstrom form: leave a leaf field that keeps cutting
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.use.2: Catch a clustered group in the same vortex
Whip a leaf vortex out along the aim line, striking the first enemy in its path for about %1$s special damage.
Range %1$s blocks; the column travels at %2$s blocks/tick, radius %3$s blocks.
Once the leaves leave, the user's Sp. Atk drops %1$s stage(s), hit or miss; the drop lasts through the fight and fades after combat.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.maelstrom.on: Maelstrom form: on impact a leaf field of radius %1$s blocks lingers, dealing about %2$s of the main hit's damage to every foe inside every %4$s until it disperses about %3$s later.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.maelstrom.of: Piercing form: one focused blade vortex punches through the target, heavier and faster, but leaves nothing behind.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.growth.0: From level %1$s the storm power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.growth.1: From level %1$s the storm power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.preference.m: On: the storm lingers at the impact point and re-cuts foes inside at intervals; costs single-target power x0.85, wind-up +3 ticks, cooldown +6 ticks. Off (piercing): one focused vortex punches through for more damage and a faster cast, but leaves nothing behind.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the storm from farther away.
On: targets with more foes around them rank higher, so the maelstrom cuts a whole group; off: ordinary ranged ordering.
world_combat.move.leafstorm.text.whirl: Leaf field blooms: each re-cut keeps %1$s%%
world_combat.move.leafstorm.text.miss: The vortex whiffs and the leaves scatter
